en.headline: CHP investigates new Mpox case involving 27-year-old man
en.dek: The patient developed genital rash and fever; he is stable in isolation at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after high-risk contact with two male strangers in Hong Kong.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Tuesday it is investigating a confirmed Mpox case involving a 27-year-old man who remains in stable condition.

The patient developed rash and vesicles at his genital organs and surrounding areas from 6 September, later followed by fever, lymphadenopathy and spread of the rash to his upper limbs, right leg and trunk. He contacted the CHP hotline on 11 September and was arranged to attend a social hygiene service clinic. Laboratory testing confirmed the monkeypox virus and he is receiving isolation treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

According to information provided by the patient, he had high-risk exposures with two male strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period. No epidemiological links with earlier confirmed cases in Hong Kong have been identified so far. The CHP is tracing contacts and will notify the World Health Organization.

Hong Kong has recorded 21 Mpox cases so far this year, including 16 local and five imported, with 12 of them occurring since August. The centre urged high-risk groups to receive vaccination and advised the public to avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of having Mpox.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新一宗猴痘個案 27歲男患者情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者生殖器官起疹發燒，潛伏期內曾與兩名陌生男子有高風險接觸，現於伊利沙伯醫院隔離治療。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日（9月15日）表示，正調查一宗確診猴痘個案，涉及一名27歲男子，目前情況穩定。
患者由9月6日起在生殖器官及附近位置出現皮疹和水泡，其後發燒、淋巴結腫大，皮疹蔓延至上肢、右腿及身軀。由於症狀持續，他於9月11日致電中心熱線，中心安排他到社會衞生科診所求診。臨床樣本經化驗後對猴痘病毒呈陽性，現於伊利沙伯醫院接受隔離治療。
根據患者資料，他於潛伏期內曾在香港與兩名陌生男子有高風險接觸。暫時沒有資料顯示個案與本港早前錄得的其他猴痘確診個案有流行病學關連。中心會設法聯繫曾有高風險接觸的人士，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
本港今年累計錄得21宗猴痘個案，包括16宗本地及5宗輸入，其中12宗為8月以來新增。中心強烈呼籲高風險目標群組接種猴痘疫苗，並提醒市民避免與疑似患者有密切身體接觸。
